items.user_turn: For the way home, I’m looking at returns between May 18 and May 20, and I’m trying to decide whether the nonstop is worth it or if a one-connection option makes more sense. If the connection is at least 2 hours, I’m okay considering it, but I have pretty low tolerance for missed connections, so I don’t want anything tight or risky.
